game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Denver Broncos

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play), while Denver Broncos owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#5 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Denver Broncos -0.8 with a fair total of 45.2 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Denver Broncos pass offence vs Los Angeles Rams pass defence, which sits +0.024 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
